# Third-party attributions — installed-package snapshot

This index records the resolved installed Unity Package Manager snapshot. It does not apply one license to all package code, and it does not establish which Editor/test/runtime components are distributed in the public repository or WebGPU player.

The ZeusRa-owned code policy is described separately in [Public project notice](PUBLIC-PROJECT-NOTICE.md). Third-party works retain their own licenses and commercial permissions; the project policy does not replace them.

All linked license/notice documents are original supplied bytes. Unity-specific terms, independently licensed components, and missing local evidence are kept distinct. No license was inferred from a package name or its opaque cache-folder suffix.

Snapshot: **79 resolved packages** (57 direct, 22 transitive), all matched to exact installed name/version; **59 license/notice text files**. Of 38 packages with a local root license, 35 name Unity-specific terms and 3 declare individual open licenses. **41 packages have no local root license text**. Every cached package.json lacked author/license fields, so ownership statements below reproduce root-license evidence only.

Unity Companion, Unity Package Distribution and Unity Terms of Service are reported as their supplied Unity-specific terms, not as blanket open-source licenses. A Unity wrapper license and a third-party component notice can coexist; for example, the Newtonsoft.Json and Mono.Cecil wrappers have Unity-specific root notices while component notices retain their respective MIT terms.

## Evidence boundaries

- The 41 missing root-license records include Burst 2.0.0, Graph Authoring 1.0.0 and 39 built-in modules. Missing text is not permission and is not a fabricated license classification.
- Four Visual Scripting license-display C# wrappers and one copyright-icon filename candidate are indexed in the private audit but are not copied as public package source or represented as text licenses. The actual Visual Scripting Third Party Notices is preserved.
- Some supplied notices contain existing replacement characters; their bytes were preserved without inventing repaired ownership text.
- This slice does not cover every engine-wide license, binary/header notice, external asset, font/audio file, generator, model, or copied third-party source in the project. It is not a complete legal-clearance or player-distribution determination.
- License URLs are retained as supplied in the originals; this local audit did not fetch or replace them.
